# 310. Minimum Height Trees

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def findMinHeightTrees(self, n, edges):
        """
        :type n: int
        :type edges: List[List[int]]
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        if n == 1:
            return [0]
        info = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        degree = [0 for _ in range(n)]
        for x, y in edges:
            info[x].append(y)
            info[y].append(x)
            degree[x] += 1
            degree[y] += 1
        q = collections.deque([])
        for i in range(n):
            if degree[i] == 1:
                q.append(i)
        while q:
            ans = []
            cur_size = len(q)
            for _ in range(cur_size):
                cur_node = q.popleft()
                ans.append(cur_node)
                for new_node in info[cur_node]:
                    degree[new_node] -= 1
                    if degree[new_node] == 1:
                        q.append(new_node)
        return ans
```
